text:
Predicates:
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
FormedIn(x, y) ::: x was formed in y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
Stable(diamondMine) ∧ FormedIn(diamondMine, wwe) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, formed in WWE.
Leads(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ∧ Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers, and Ivy Nile.
Feud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
Leads(roderickStrong, creedBrothers) ::: Roderick strong leads the Creed Brothers.
